replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
Hello,

You have been temp-banned for earning more than 10 infractions. Your ban will not be appealed as it is valid. However, when you return. Please do not gain any more infractions, as when you reach 20 you will be permanently banned. If you wish to check your infractions do so here.
